alternatives_rejected.why: E1 shows an error deviation but no latency or resource signal; the top resource anomaly and the latency jump are on currencyservice (E1, E2), and adservice is not on the checkout critical path.
Its p90 rise (700%) is smaller than currencyservice's p50 rise (1708%) in E1, and E2 shows callers waiting on currencyservice, which is consistent with checkout latency being downstream impact.

proposed_fix.description: Find the source of disk I/O pressure on the currencyservice pod or node, such as a noisy neighbor, runaway writes or a log flood, and stop it. Then reschedule currencyservice onto a healthy node or scale it out, and confirm caller-observed latency returns to about 5ms. Caveat: E2 shows currencyservice's own span time is flat (0.14->0.1ms) while caller-observed time rose 19.5x. That pattern also fits a network delay fault, so check network metrics as well.
